title: Few parents know the age rule for ChatGPT
format: Direct to camera: a fact most parents miss, then one thing to do tonight
goal: Parents learn ChatGPT’s age rule and one easy next step: ask their kid about it at dinner and look at one chat together.
trends: hook: “few people realize that _” (a reveal hook on the rise)
topic: kids doing schoolwork with ChatGPT (6 videos, 4M views)

hook.line: Few parents know the age rule for ChatGPT.
hook.why: Opening on a rule parents assume they know makes them wait for the answer; the text on screen carries it for viewers with the sound off.

shots.framing: Vertical, chest-up, the phone level with your eyes. A home desk, a lamp and a bookshelf behind you.
shots.action: Eyebrows up on “age rule”, as if sharing a secret.
shots.line: Few parents know the age rule for ChatGPT.

shots.framing: Same angle, a little closer (a zoom in the edit works too).
shots.action: Hold up one finger, then a second one on “eighteen”.
shots.line: It’s actually thirteen. And until eighteen, your kid can only use it with your permission.

shots.framing: B-roll: a dinner table from above, an adult’s and a kid’s hands passing a bowl (no faces).
shots.action: Hands only, an easy, ordinary moment.
shots.line: Tonight at dinner, calmly ask your kid if they already have an account.

shots.action: Warm smile, point at the lens on the last word.
shots.line: Then ask them to show you their last chat.

shots.action: Freeze on the smile for a beat before the loop.

filming: Shoot vertical (9:16) at 1080p or 4K, 30 fps; lock focus and exposure on your face.
Put the phone on a shelf or a tripod level with your eyes, so you never look down at it.
Face a window or a soft lamp; avoid a bright window behind you.
Use a clip-on mic, or keep the phone close in a quiet room; record without music.
Film each line twice, with a short pause before and after it, so the cuts are clean.
Stay in the centre of the frame: the bottom holds the captions and the right edge the app’s buttons.
edit: Trim every pause between lines to 0.3 s at most.
Shot 2: zoom in 10–15% at the 3 s mark.
Spoken words as short caption groups low in the safe zone; the on-screen lines at the top.
Mix your voice to about −14 LUFS; for a bed, a quiet piano track from Mixkit, or a trending sound picked in TikTok, kept near 10%.
sound: Just your voice; at most a quiet music bed or a trending sound in the app, about 10% under you.

facts.claim: ChatGPT: users must be 13 or older (older where a country sets a higher age of consent); users under 18 need a parent’s or legal guardian’s permission.
facts.note: Keep it off the post: it is for checking. A few EU countries set the consent age higher, up to 16.

generate_instead.note: To generate it instead of filming: one 15 s MiniMax H3 take with English speech, its first frame from an AI host image (about $1.33: the image $0.13, the take $1.20).
generate_instead.host_image_prompt: A photo that looks like a still from a selfie video: a dad of about forty sits at his home desk and talks to his phone, which leans on a pile of books; shoulders and head in frame, his face near the centre, caught mid-sentence with his eyebrows a little raised; grey hoodie, short beard, natural skin; behind him a desk lamp, a mug of tea and a shelf of board games; warm light from the lamp on the right, a little grain. Natural look only: no retouching, no studio light, and nothing written, no logos, no watermarks.
generate_instead.video_prompt: Start from Image 1, unchanged, as the first frame. [0 to 3 seconds] The dad lifts his eyebrows and says: "Few parents know the age rule for ChatGPT." [3 to 8 seconds] The camera creeps in; he shows one finger, then two: "It's actually thirteen. And until eighteen, your kid can only use it with your permission." [8 to 11 seconds] Cut to a dinner table from above, an adult's and a kid's hands passing a bowl, while he keeps talking: "Tonight at dinner, calmly ask your kid if they already have an account." [11 to 15 seconds] Cut back to the desk; he smiles and points at the lens: "Then ask them to show you their last chat." Audio: only his own voice, near and clear, over a quiet room; no music. Keep the picture clean: no captions, no stickers, no watermarks.
